title: Mods run their tests on all three systems in CI
why: Finding from the thread fixing the decision watch on the Mac, Oct 26: CI runs mod tests on Linux only, so a Mac-only bug in decision-watch went uncaught, and the watch has never judged a Mac turn (c29).
note: Checked at claude-settings 3f71d6b: in .github/workflows/gates.yml the 'Mod tests' step (and the plain-english-map skill tests beside it) sit in the ubuntu-latest job; the windows-latest and shell-macos jobs do not run them. Incident: c29, decision-watch needed `which -a python3 python` to exit 0, which fails on a Mac (no `python`); fix #580. Fix shape: run the same mod-test step in the Windows and macOS jobs under the same `mods` scope flag, one step definition, no copy. It changes what a gate checks, so it is a lane with a red proof (a mod test that fails only on macOS) and a reviewer. Placed ahead of c54 (triage, Oct 26): an incident showed the gap, and it hides bugs in every mod; a candidate for batch 1, the build advisor's call.
